campaign: Constrained RSI bootstrap: verified substrate, experiment plane, and automatic composition
doctrine: Follow skill.md. This file is the SINGLE plan authority: campaign design and execution dispatch live here and nowhere else. Every open step has a failable verifier; steps declare depends_on and the queue order must respect them; plan complete means campaign complete by construction.

items.title: Place goldens, evaluator definitions, promotion policy and champion aliases beyond candidate-worker reach through a distinct OS/service identity or remote protected authority; require external provenance naming the producing tool and version for any golden change

steps.title: Place goldens, evaluator definitions, promotion policy and champion aliases beyond candidate-worker reach through a distinct OS/service identity or remote protected authority; require external provenance naming the producing tool and version for any golden change
steps.rationale: THE FIXED POINT. Goldens originate from HF transformers 4.57.1 / torch 2.12.0+cu126 and pinned llama.cpp; fixtures/carbon_golden.json stamps its producing versions and llama_*_grad_golden.json carry torch autograd gradients. The system cannot author them. Every Phase D row is safe exactly to the degree it is ultimately scored against artifacts the system did not produce.

items.title: Issue GPU-hour budget tokens for autonomous proposal; enforce cancellation and containment; exceeding a budget requires an external decision

steps.title: Issue GPU-hour budget tokens for autonomous proposal; enforce cancellation and containment; exceeding a budget requires an external decision
steps.rationale: Bounded autonomy is the only kind that can be left running unattended. Query counts, GPU-hours and later resource dimensions use one common immutable budget/token mechanism with typed units, owner, subject, issued amount, consumed amount, expiry and external override evidence.

items.title: Make reversibility a checked invariant -- immutable champion retention, compare-and-set activation, decisions carrying decider identity -- and exercise a rollback drill that demonstrably restores the prior champion

steps.rationale: An untested rollback is not a rollback. The drill is the row, not the invariant alone.

steps.title: Add experiment/job leases carrying GPU memory, CPU, RAM and wall-time estimates, heartbeat expiry, cancellation, checkpoint/resume, abandoned-job reconciliation, retry identity, recovery cost and actual measurements; recommendation-only at first
steps.rationale: cmd/plan -lease-report covers worktree/resource advisory leases for development. Runtime experiments need their own lease projection, but both consumers should reuse common resource request and measured-outcome primitives now that the abstraction has two real owners. Experiment-specific lifecycle state stays in runrecord; plan owns recommendation and capacity assessment.

steps.rationale: Revision 1 listed compose as missing and never closed it. A trained adapter is not an assembled model; without this row nothing produces the descendant artifact that descendant-improvement measures.

steps.title: Port the bit-packed hypervector index with catalog-derived signature width, combining the lexical organ signal with the existing distributional signal
steps.rationale: Deliberately last in phase B. Do not automate selection before composition-viability establishes that selection matters and hand-run bridges reveal what ranking needs. The signals are complementary: lexical says what a tensor is called, distributional says how it behaves.

steps.rationale: First row whose passing means actual self-improvement occurred rather than that the contract holds. Generation depth 1.

items.title: Make the corpus-to-topology derivation profile a content-addressed artifact with lineage and promotion record, so the system proposes derivation profiles and is judged on the models they produce

steps.title: Make the corpus-to-topology derivation profile a content-addressed artifact with lineage and promotion record, so the system proposes derivation profiles and is judged on the models they produce
steps.rationale: AdaptiveDerivationProfile() returns eight pinned scalars frozen to reproduce the adaptive oracle. Promotion to artifact closes eight magic rows by derivation rather than a better story -- the RSI loop satisfies Magic Discipline as a side effect.

items.title: Promote an evaluator only if it correctly ranks a held-out set of models with known-good and known-bad outcomes drawn from the sealed oracle set, approved by generation N-1 authority

steps.title: Promote an evaluator only if it correctly ranks a held-out set of models with known-good and known-bad outcomes drawn from the sealed oracle set, approved by generation N-1 authority
steps.rationale: The classic RSI failure is a system improving its evaluator into one that approves everything. Safe only because the ranking set is externally sourced and unauthorable, and because the approving authority predates the candidate.

items.title: Train the proposer ranking on the refusal ledger so retrieval becomes a learned prior over what composes successfully rather than a fixed similarity function

steps.title: Train the proposer ranking on the refusal ledger so retrieval becomes a learned prior over what composes successfully rather than a fixed similarity function
steps.rationale: Where refusal records stop being an audit trail and become the most valuable dataset in the store: passed and refused bridges are labelled data no external source can supply. Must respect proposer blinding -- the ranking trains on refusal reasons, never on promotion or audit split results.
